scope.summary: Protocol desync, ORA-03113/03114/03135 and empty-SCN results are classified as connection loss; a lost oracle_query (read-executor ProtocolUnsynchronized or connector-backed admission-probe loss) is retried exactly once on a fresh lease through retry_decision(.., ProvenIdempotentRead); DML loss returns protocol_unsynchronized (never rolled_back) and is not replayed; DDL loss returns ddl_outcome_unknown; checkpoint loss reports rolled_back without re-lease; keepalive_minutes defaults to 10 with a doctor-reported skip for complete descriptors; bounded lease lifecycle events.
out_of_scope: Real firewall idle-drop and ADB recovery (T9.6); cancellation outcomes (T2.4); cursor discard (T2.7).

entry_points.name: oracle_query / oracle_execute over an external MCP client after a server-side ALTER SYSTEM KILL SESSION (W4, release binary)
entry_points.trace: w4_runtime_issue47_killed_session_recovers pass on free23, xe21, xe18 (scoped and full runs): the first oracle_query after the kill returns C=1 without switch_profile. w4_runtime_issue47_killed_session_dml_not_replayed pass on all 3 lanes: CONNECTION_FAILED + statement_outcome=protocol_unsynchronized, driver no longer accepts rolled_back (450501f0), independent reread unchanged.

entry_points.name: oraclemcp doctor --online (defaulted keepalive)
entry_points.trace: Live FREE23 E2E_ORACLE: easy-connect and complete-descriptor profiles without keepalive_minutes both connect; check 12 reports EXPIRE_TIME every 10m and, for the descriptor, that the default was not injected because the descriptor owns EXPIRE_TIME.

entry_points.name: dispatch/db/config unit tests (verifier re-execution)
entry_points.trace: Clean export of ef2885a5: cargo test -p oraclemcp --lib 561 passed; -p oraclemcp-db --lib 670 passed; -p oraclemcp-core --lib 828 passed. retry_decision is called from dispatch_with_cx_inner (10eaadec) and ef2885a5 routes connector-backed admission-probe loss into it; DdlOutcomeUnknown is produced in execute_sql_inner for statement_level >= DDL.

limitations: Live kill happens between statements, so the live DML case fails in the audit-evidence preflight ('no statement was executed') and reports protocol_unsynchronized; an UPDATE dying while on the wire is proven only by the mock test issue47_desync_dml_returns_typed_outcome_without_replay.

The live transparent retry exercised is the admission-probe path added in ef2885a5; the read-executor ProtocolUnsynchronized retry path is unit-proven only. The failed first attempt leaves a lane_lifecycle UNKNOWN_DISCARDED audit record, not an oracle_query attempt record.

Two acceptance test names differ from the frozen list: ORA-03113/03114/03135 coverage is in query_and_execute_uncertain_state_markers_are_each_detected, and the defaulted-descriptor skip in defaulted_descriptor_keepalive_skip_is_reported / defaulted_keepalive_is_reported_as_descriptor_owned.

10eaadec repurposed recoverable_pinned_quarantine_recycles_switchable_session_on_retry into issue47_desync_read_recycles_and_retries_once; the old oracle_sample_rows Cancelled->recycle scenario and its exact query-count and catalog-generation assertions are no longer tested.
